unlisted_practices: Treat LLMs used in medicine like nascent medical professionals who must meet minimum standards of competence and responsibility.
Subject LLMs used in medicine to measurable, product-like standards of safety and performance.
Pair LLM oversight with reimbursement incentives and legal liability so LLMs are treated on par with other diagnosers and treaters of US patients.
Convert non-binding AI guidelines into binding, enforceable, measurable standards for AI in medicine.
Define AI transparency standards clearly and specifically, in measurable, testable terms tailored to audience tiers, rather than calling for 'just enough' transparency.
